name: Historic Mosque City of Bagerhat
description: Tucked into the delta country of southwestern Bangladesh, Bagerhat was once the 15th-century city of Khalifatabad, founded by the Turkic general Ulugh Khan Jahan. Its quiet lanes shelter dozens of old brick mosques, tombs and water tanks, many with terracotta decoration. The star is the Sixty Dome Mosque, whose 77 domes rise above a forest of slender pillars, and Khan Jahan's own tomb lies nearby.
